resolution.title: Build and install redis-dump-load Python 3 package in host image
resolution.description:
Fix https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/issues/4656

Tested these cases with `sonic-mellanox.bin` image
1. `redis-dump` (python2)
2. `python3 /usr/local/bin/redis-dump`
3. `sonic-db-dump` (python2)
4. `python3 /usr/local/bin/sonic-db-dump`
